items.title: Brandon Aiyuk: Cut loose by Niners
items.text:
The 49ers waived Aiyuk on Monday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

items.title: Woody Marks: 'Trending in right direction' for Week 12
items.text:
Head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that Marks (concussion) is "trending in the right direction," and the Texans "are hopeful to have him" for Sunday's game against the Ravens, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jalen Coker: Avoids concussion
items.text:
Hrad coach Dave Canales said Monday that Coker has been cleared from the concussion protocol, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Practicing, but not expected to play Wednesday
items.text:
Jacobs (finger) participated in Monday's practice to some degree, but is still not expected to play Wednesday against the Rams, Bill Huber of SI.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Malik Willis: Avoids surgery for now
items.text:
Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that at this time, surgery to address Willis' groin/core injury is not foreseen, Joe Schad of The Palm Beach Post reports.
